status.en: 208 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Abuja, Lagos and Plateau State.
status.nb: 208 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Abuja, Lagos og Plateau State.

summary.en: Security forces used drones and CCTV to foil a terrorist attack in Riyom, while gunmen killed a traditional ruler and four vigilantes in Plateau and stormed a mining site, killing two people. In Zamfara, gunmen killed three police officers during a night patrol and three officers in a separate patrol attack. Islamic State claimed responsibility for a deadly attack on a military camp, and gunmen killed three policemen after attacking a night patrol team in Zamfara. The army chief visited Borno as parents of abducted children lamented 155 days in captivity, and 27 abducted victims, including a six-month-old infant, were rescued. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker brukte droner og overvåkningskameraer for å avverge et terrorangrep i Riyom, mens bevæpnede menn drepte en tradisjonell hersker og fire vakter i Plateau og stormet en gruve, der to personer ble drept. I Zamfara drepte bevæpnede menn tre politifolk under en nattevakt og tre offiserer i et separat angrep på en patrulje. Den islamske staten (IS) tok ansvar for et dødelig angrep på en militærleir, og bevæpnede menn drepte tre politifolk etter å ha angrepet et nattevaktteam i Zamfara. Hærenes sjef besøkte Borno mens foreldre til bortførte barn klaget over 155 dager i fangenskap, og 27 bortførte personer, inkludert et seks-måned gammelt spedbarn, ble reddet. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Boko Haram insurgency
background.extract: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.
